evidence: News leading into May 18, 2022 reflects significant market distress following the Terra/Luna fallout. Acute stablecoin anxiety persists, marked by over $7.5 billion in Tether redemptions, draining liquidity from crypto markets. Concurrently, the Crypto Fear & Greed Index dropped to extreme lows not seen since March 2020. Although some analysts point to technical bottom signals and accumulation among whole-coin holders, prevailing short-term market sentiment remains dominated by contagion fear and capital outflows, tilting the 24-hour directional outlook downward.
limitations: Several articles focus on long-term adoption or corporate announcements (e.g., El Salvador conference, Temasek holdings, mining operations) that offer minimal direct pricing signals over a 24-hour horizon.
Short-term sentiment is highly reactive to broader stablecoin de-pegging volatility not fully quantifiable via news headlines alone.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
